parts.text: Leader of the Federalist Party, Mr [...] has agreed to have a private talk. Deep in your thoughts, you almost jumped when your secretary opened the door and said that Mr [...] was there.

parts.name: FPL
parts.text: Good morning, Prime Minister, to what do I owe this sudden invitation? Did you like our recent action?

options.description: I'm not sure 'like' is the appropriate word. You, and your colleagues are putting our international relations at risk for a marginal political gain! I won't tolerate it for much longer.
It depends on how do you define 'like'. Do I agree with what you wanted to tell? Yes. Are such demonstrations good for our common cause? Absolutely not.
I wanted to discuss joint action on the issue you underlined.

parts.name: FPL
parts.text: Threats don't work on me! For many years your government ignored our voice and did everything the Hegemon asked for. Your propaganda says we have such a close relations blabla, but the truth is we are getting colonised economically and have nothing meaningful in return for that. Military protection? Who exactly threatens us aside from the Matheuchellian themselves, who still occupy Kachakonian island of Chara!

options.description: And what choice do we have? Do you really believe that pissing off the greatest empire in world's history is going to fix any problems?

You've got a point, but listen. We can't change the world immediately. There a couple of deals waiting to be sealed that require approval from Matheuchelles. That's a really bad timing on your side, with demonstrations. If you care about the country, stop your actions for a couple of months and then you are free to do whatever you like to.
Kachakonyan island? Maybe you should go and ask people out there what they think about that first? Last time I checked 80% of Charans were happy with the current situation.

parts.name: FPL
parts.text: Not pissing off, but engaging in discussions. You are right that alone we aren't in a position to challenge Matheuchelles, but we aren't the only country in the similar spot. That's a hard pill to swallow, but we need an agreement with Graonians.

options.description: Agreement with Graonians against the Hegemon? So it's true what they say about you. You are mad! I'm sorry, but you give me no other choice! Either you stop spreading this dangerous propaganda or we will talk differently. Pardon! Internal security agency will talk with you differently.

parts.name: FPL
parts.text: Can't wait to hear from them! I see that you are Matheuchelles' pawn like the rest of our elites and I promise you, history will remember you as such.
He grounded the last sentence out and left the room, slamming the door in the process.

parts.name: FPL
parts.text: And what exactly do I stand to gain return?

options.description: You'd better be joking. I'm not negotiating with people like you!
Kachakonyan island? Maybe you should go and ask people out there what they think about that first? Last time I checked 80% of Charans were happy with the current situation.
